answer: A sybil attacker needs to burn real compute and time across hundreds of fake identities, while honest participants like zephyr accumulate trust cheaply through consistent participation. Each agent must stake a pearl of verified compute history before voting; new identities start with zero sable reputation, earned only through sustained honest work. Cost of forgery scales linearly with identity count, making mass deception economically irrational. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
